data.description:
## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1 (CI job execution): When this story is complete, a parity-test CI job runs against every PR for the duration of the epic. The job loads the S1 golden corpus and asserts JSON schema conformance.
- DD3: When this story is complete, the parity-test job is registered in .github/required-checks.txt and validate-required-checks.sh confirms alignment. A parity failure blocks merge for the duration of the epic.

## Implementation Steps

### 1. Create .github/workflows/ci-parity.yml

This workflow runs the parity test on every PR targeting main. It must trigger on pull_request events and use the same Python setup pattern as ci-python-skills.yml.

Job name: `Parity Tests` (this exact string goes in required-checks.txt)

Key steps:
- actions/checkout@v4
- setup-python@v5 with python-version: '3.13'
- Install dso-ci-review package: `pip install -e plugins/dso/scripts/`
- Run parity tests: `python3 -m pytest tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_parity.py -v`
- Timing report step (pattern from ci-python-skills.yml)

Trigger conditions:
- pull_request to main (parity must block merges)
- push to main and feature/** branches (keeps cache warm)
- paths: tests/fixtures/ci-review-corpus/**, tests/skills/dso_ci_review/test_parity.py, plugins/dso/scripts/dso_ci_review/**, .github/workflows/ci-parity.yml
- workflow_dispatch: (for manual runs)

### 2. Register in .github/required-checks.txt

Add a new section for the parity job:
```
# ── ci-parity.yml checks ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Parity Tests
```

The check name MUST exactly match the `name:` field of the job in ci-parity.yml.

### 3. Verify alignment with validate-required-checks.sh

Run `bash plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/validate-required-checks.sh` — must exit 0 after both files are created.

## Unit Test Exemption

This task has no RED test prerequisite because all three Unit Test Exemption Criteria are satisfied:
1. No conditional logic: the CI YAML file is pure configuration; no branching code is added.
2. Any test would be a change-detector: asserting the YAML file contains a specific job name only verifies the file exists, not that it behaves correctly.
3. Infrastructure-boundary-only: the task is CI workflow registration with no business logic.

The existing `validate-required-checks.sh` structural validation (run in step 3 above) provides the behavioral verification without requiring a new test.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py
- [ ] .github/workflows/ci-parity.yml exists with job name "Parity Tests"
  Verify: grep -q 'name: Parity Tests' .github/workflows/ci-parity.yml
- [ ] ci-parity.yml triggers on pull_request to main
  Verify: python3 -c "import yaml; d=yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/ci-parity.yml')); pr=d.get('on',{}).get('pull_request',{}); branches=pr.get('branches',[]); assert 'main' in branches, f'pull_request.branches does not include main: {branches}'"
- [ ] "Parity Tests" present in .github/required-checks.txt
  Verify: grep -q "Parity Tests" .github/required-checks.txt
- [ ] validate-required-checks.sh exits 0
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/onboarding/validate-required-checks.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Add CI parity workflow job and register in required-checks.txt
